extraction.name: EgoLife Dataset
extraction.description: A comprehensive 300-hour egocentric, interpersonal, multiview, and multimodal daily life dataset with intensive annotation.
extraction.creator: The EgoLife Team
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Six participants lived together for one week, continuously recording their daily activities using AI glasses for multimodal egocentric video capture, along with synchronized third-person-view video references.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: First-person video from AI glasses, third-person video from fixed indoor cameras, and synchronized multimodal signal data including millimeter-wave radars and WiFi signals.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: Seven-day period in Beijing and a one-day session in Milan.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: All identifiable faces and sensitive license plates were blurred, and audio containing sensitive topics was muted.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The pipeline synchronizes multi-source data (video, audio, IMU) from Aria glasses and GoPro cameras using EgoSync codebase, processes them through privacy protection (EgoBlur), dense captioning (EgoCaption), and transcription (EgoTranscript) modules.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Videos were split into 5-minute clips and slowed to 0.8x speed for annotators to provide continuous narrations. GPT-4o-mini merged phrases into captions, which were verified by human annotators. For QA, GPT-4o generated timestamped questions that were provided to annotators as SRT files. Annotators filtered and refined these questions, retaining only those requiring information from at least five minutes prior, and generated distractors for multiple-choice questions.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: A video editing software with dubbing functions (Capcut).
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: A rigorous selection and refinement process filtered 100K QA candidates down to 1K high-quality questions per participant, followed by a final round of curation resulting in a carefully crafted set of 500 QA per participant.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Speech recognition (Whisper), diarization algorithm, GPT-4o-mini, and GPT-4o.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The project is ongoing, with plans to expand the dataset to cover a broader range of languages, locations, and activities, and encouraging community contributions.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Participant and bystander faces, vehicle license plates, sensitive audio segments containing private information, and sensitive screen content (e.g., mobile or computer screens displaying passwords or personal data).
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Potential to enhance human-AI interaction in personalized assistance and context-aware applications, improving quality of life for individuals needing consistent support, such as the elderly or those with cognitive challenges.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset intentionally started with a narrow setting (single language/scenario), sacrificing some generalizability.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Studying long-duration activities, interpersonal dynamics, and contextual interactions; evaluating personalized AI assistance through long-context, life-oriented question-answering tasks.

name.evidence: This effort resulted in the EgoLife Dataset , a comprehensive 300-hour egocentric, interpersonal, multiview, and multimodal daily life dataset...

description.evidence: This effort resulted in the EgoLife Dataset , a comprehensive 300-hour egocentric, interpersonal, multiview, and multimodal daily life dataset with intensive annotation.

inLanguage.evidence: The primary language of the EgoLife dataset is Chinese. All the annotations (transcripts, captions, QAs) are primarily in Chinese and translated into English.

isLiveDataset.evidence: This ongoing project aims to document human daily activities in natural environments...

rai:dataCollection.evidence: we conducted a comprehensive data collection study where six participants lived together for one week, continuously recording their daily activities—including discussions, shopping, cooking, socializing, and entertainment—using AI glasses for multimodal egocentric video capture, along with synchronized thirdperson-view video references.

rai:dataCollectionType.evidence: Each participant wore Meta Aria glasses [ 1] and captured multimodal egocentric videos. To enhance the dataset with third-person perspectives, 15 strategically placed GoPro cameras recorded the participants’ activities from multiple angles. Additionally, millimeter-wave radars provided spatial and motion data

rai:dataCollectionRawData.evidence: First-person video from AI glasses... Third-person video from fixed indoor cameras... Synchronized multimodal signal data, including millimeter-wave radars and WiFi signals

rai:dataCollectionTimeframe.evidence: The EgoLife dataset was collected over a seven-day period with six volunteers residing in a custom-designed environment... Milan : A one-day session capturing approximately 6 hours of activity

rai:dataManipulationProtocol.evidence: The dataset underwent rigorous data cleaning to ensure quality and remove any sensitive or low-quality segments. All identifiable faces and sensitive license plates were blurred, and audio containing sensitive topics was muted.

rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol.evidence: The pipeline synchronizes multi-source data (video, audio, IMU) from Aria glasses and GoPro cameras using EgoSync codebase, processes them through privacy protection ( EgoBlur ), dense captioning (EgoCaption ), and transcription ( EgoTranscript ) modules

rai:dataAnnotationProtocol.evidence: We split all the videos into 5-minute clips, which were slowed to 0.8 ×speed, allowing annotators to provide continuous, detailed narrations by talking without pauses... Using GPT-4o-mini, we merged related phrases into 25K “merged captions,”... verified by human annotators... AI-generated questions were provided to annotators as SRT files... Only questions requiring information from at least five minutes prior were retained... Annotators also generated distractors for multiple-choice questions

rai:dataAnnotationPlatform.evidence: The captioning tool is a video editing software with dubbing functions [ 92].

rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis.evidence: After a rigorous selection and refinement process, we filtered the 100K QA candidates down to 1K high-quality questions per participant—less than 1% of the original pool—for further meticulous revision. This final round of curation resulted in a carefully crafted set of 500 QA per participant.

rai:machineAnnotationTools.evidence: applying speech recognition [ 90] to generate initial timestamped transcripts. Using an open-source diarization algorithm [ 91]... Using GPT-4o-mini, we merged related phrases... summarized by GPT-4o... fed “visual-audio captions” into GPT-4o in batches, generating around 100K timestamped questions

rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan.evidence: This ongoing project aims to document human daily activities in natural environments... Looking ahead, we plan to expand the dataset to cover a broader range of languages, locations, and activities... we see great value in expanding the project while encouraging community contributions

rai:personalSensitiveInformation.evidence: Blurring of faces and identifiers: All participant faces were blurred to anonymize identities. Additionally, bystanders’ faces and vehicle license plates appearing in the footage were thoroughly blurred. Audio muting: Sensitive audio segments containing private or potentially identifiable information were muted... Screen privacy: Frames containing sensitive screen content, such as mobile or computer screens, were reviewed, and any private information was blurred.

rai:dataSocialImpact.evidence: The development of EgoButler and the EgoLifeQA dataset holds significant potential to enhance human-AI interaction, particularly in personalized assistance and context-aware applications... improving quality of life, especially for individuals needing consistent support, such as the elderly or those with cognitive challenges.

rai:dataLimitations.evidence: As the first step toward a realistic egocentric life assistant, we intentionally started with a narrow setting to build a strong foundation, sacrificing some generalizability (e.g., single language/scenario).

rai:dataUseCases.evidence: The dataset provides an unprecedented resource for studying long-duration activities, interpersonal dynamics, and contextual interactions... EgoLifeQA benchmark, a set of long-context, life-oriented question-answering tasks that assess the effectiveness of personalized AI assistance.
